# gws recipe: Collect Form responses

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the collect-form-responses recipe: retrieve and review responses from a Google Form in 3 commands — list the forms, get the form details, list the responses in a table. A recipe, not a reference: it complements `googleworkspace-cli-gws-forms` (the raw Forms API reference, lot 33) — the most common Forms use case as a concrete flow. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
